note: Written BEFORE FE implementation. 'actual' and 'result' fields are blank — to be filled during Gate 2 execution.

cases.title: Query without diacritics matches module name with diacritics
preconditions: modules.json contains module with name 'Đăng tin BĐS'
steps: Type 'dang tin' into #search-input (no diacritics, no accents)
cases.expected: Module 'Đăng tin BĐS' appears in results. stripDiacritics('Đăng tin BĐS') = 'Dang tin BDS' and stripDiacritics('dang tin') = 'dang tin'; 'dang tin bds'.includes('dang tin') is true.

cases.title: Query with full diacritics still matches (backward compatibility)
preconditions: modules.json contains module with name 'Đăng tin BĐS'
cases.expected: Module 'Đăng tin BĐS' appears in results. After stripDiacritics both sides normalize to equivalent ASCII; match succeeds.

cases.title: Query in UPPERCASE without diacritics matches
preconditions: modules.json contains module with name 'Đăng tin BĐS'
cases.expected: Module 'Đăng tin BĐS' appears in results. stripDiacritics applies .toLowerCase() so 'DANG TIN' → 'dang tin', which matches stripped name.

cases.title: Query without diacritics matches on description field
preconditions: modules.json 'dang_tin' has description 'Toàn bộ quy trình đăng tin từ trang chủ đến gửi duyệt'
cases.expected: Module 'Đăng tin BĐS' appears. matchSearch() applies stripDiacritics on m.description so 'toan bo quy trinh dang tin tu trang chu den gui duyet' includes 'toan bo quy trinh'.

cases.title: Query without diacritics matches on role field
preconditions: At least one module has role 'Đầu chủ'
cases.expected: All modules with role 'Đầu chủ' appear. matchSearch() applies stripDiacritics on m.role: 'dau chu' matches stripped 'Dau chu'.

cases.title: Mixed diacritics query (some letters accented, some not) still matches
steps: Type 'loc kho tai' into #search-input (no diacritics, partial)
cases.expected: Module matching 'Lọc kho tài nguyên' appears. Each character's diacritic is stripped independently by NFD normalization.

cases.title: highlight() uses original query, not stripped version — diacriticed query highlights correctly
cases.expected: <mark>Đăng tin</mark> wraps the matching portion. highlight() is called with the original query (with diacritics), and the module name contains the same characters. The <mark> tag is present with the exact original text.

cases.title: highlight() NOT modified — query without diacritics does NOT produce <mark> (accent-stripped highlight is out of scope)
cases.expected: Module appears in results (TC-VS-001 passes) but the name text 'Đăng tin BĐS' does NOT have a <mark> wrapper — because highlight() still uses the original query and 'Đăng tin' does not literally contain 'dang tin'. This is the accepted design per spec.

cases.title: Empty query shows all modules (no change from existing behaviour)
cases.expected: All modules for the active role tab are shown. matchSearch() returns true immediately when query is falsy — stripDiacritics is never called. Behavior identical to pre-fix.

cases.title: Whitespace-only query is treated as empty (no crash, shows all)
cases.expected: Behavior depends on whether STATE.searchQuery is trimmed before passing to matchSearch. If not trimmed: stripDiacritics('   ') = '   '; no module name contains '   ' so empty state is shown with a search icon. If trimmed: all modules shown. Either way no uncaught exception. Document the actual behaviour.

cases.title: Very long query (200+ characters) does not crash stripDiacritics or matchSearch
steps: Paste a 250-character string of random Vietnamese text into #search-input
cases.expected: No uncaught JS exception. Page remains responsive. Empty state shown because no module matches a 250-char query. stripDiacritics handles long strings without error.

cases.title: Regression: role tab filter still works correctly alongside accent-folded search
cases.expected: Only modules belonging to role 'Đầu chủ' AND matching 'đăng tin' (accent-folded) are shown. Role filter is applied before search filter — this ordering is unchanged.

cases.title: Regression: grid view and list view both render correctly after an accent-folded search
preconditions: At least one module matches 'loc kho'
steps: Confirm results appear in default view
Click #btn-list to switch to list view
Confirm same results appear in list view
Confirm same results in grid view
cases.expected: Matched modules render correctly in both .modules-grid and .modules-list layouts. renderModules() is called on view toggle and re-applies the current query. No visual breakage.

cases.title: Regression: numeric query (e.g. module step count) does not crash stripDiacritics
cases.expected: stripDiacritics receives a string ('12'); String(s).normalize() is a no-op for ASCII digits; .replace() returns '12'; .toLowerCase() returns '12'. No exception. Empty state or matching result displayed.

cases.title: XSS: HTML tags in accent-folded query are still escaped before DOM injection
steps: Inspect DOM of empty state and any rendered module cards
cases.expected: No script executes. The query passed to highlight() is the raw STATE.searchQuery string; highlight() calls escapeHtml(text) on the module field before regex replacement, and escapeHtml(q) on the query in the empty-state message. stripDiacritics is called only inside matchSearch() for comparison; it does not affect the DOM path. XSS protection is unchanged.

cases.title: Regex special characters in query do not crash stripDiacritics or matchSearch
cases.expected: No uncaught JS exception. stripDiacritics uses String.normalize() and String.replace() with a Unicode property escape — neither is affected by regex special chars in the input value. matchSearch uses String.prototype.includes() (not regex) so special chars are treated as literals. highlight() already escapes the query with regex-escape before building a RegExp — this path is unchanged.
